task.problem_statement: Users need to obtain the unitary matrix represented by a Tequila circuit, including circuits containing symbolic rotation parameters, so that circuit behavior can be compared directly with matrix representations.
requirements: Return the dense unitary matrix for a circuit containing Hadamard and controlled-X operations in the repository qubit-order convention.
Resolve supplied variable values when producing the unitary matrix of a parameterized Pauli rotation.
Preserve existing circuit construction, variable mapping, and moment behavior.

interface.Name: QCircuit.to_matrix
interface.Description: Returns the circuit unitary; variables maps symbolic parameters to numerical values.
